title: Ugly resumes get you hired
description:

They skip the fluff and keep it real, the stuff that gets you hired.

Here's the link to our 1,500+ customizable & simple resume templates

transcript: the ugly resume is probably going to get you the interview what does the ugly resume have a summary portion right here let me know what this person currently does with how many years of experience and what they're looking to do clear bolded for the title and the company Le two bullet points in each position with measurable impact all the keywords that recruits to be looking for 3 to five bullet points for your most recent position 2 to four for everything after it's easy to read and just in the few seconds I scan this resume I already know what this person is looking for can your resume tell that story if not then use the ugly resume
